Qt 6.10.1 libraries are dynamically linked. Full Halab sources and CMake build files are in ../../Source relative to this folder. Compatible Qt DLLs may be replaced.
Qt sources: https://download.qt.io/archive/qt/6.10/6.10.1/single/
Licensing: https://doc.qt.io/qt-6.10/licensing.html
Qt copyright: The Qt Company Ltd. and other contributors.
MinGW/GCC runtime license notices are included in the subfolders.
Node.js license and its third-party notices are in ../tools/Node-LICENSE.txt.
